dc:description: One pooled degree × destination or All outside × specification × role state × denominator basis.
dc:title: Outside roles
notes: All cells are described as lexical strings to preserve source decimal precision and codes. Parse measures using units and status fields.

A blank CSV cell alone does not identify missingness: valid blank keys, structurally inapplicable fields and unavailable values are distinguished by the dataset contract, status columns and companion JSON.
Source units and values are unchanged; the interface converts probabilities to percentages only for display.

Field bindings: source_key: Ordered values of the selected primary source key; use source_table_id to distinguish All outside from destination rows.; value: Destination observed/scored: pct_within_destination / pct_scored_within_destination; All outside observed/scored: pct_outside / pct_scored_outside.; numerator: n; unavailable scored-only unscored share has null numerator with source count retained; denominator: destination_n/destination_scored_n or outside_n/outside_scored_n by source and basis; category: state; category_label: state_label; destination: source destination; literal all_outside only for outside_role_profiles
Reuse terms remain source-specific; see the dataset manifest and released access notices.
